title: rosa × makinoana
intro: Rosa × makinoana, commonly known as Makino's rose, is a hybrid species of rose plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × makinoana include its ability to act as an anti-stress agent, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer activities.
